# Webhook delivery — spec

## Requirements

**R1 — Callback URL.** An administrator pastes a callback URL in the settings screen; on every new order the server POSTs the order payload to it.
*Source: "send new orders to my own endpoint"*

**R2 — Admin only.** Only administrators can view or change the callback URL.
*Source: invented — approved 2026-09-21*

## Security-relevant surfaces
- [x] User-controlled URLs / server-side outbound requests
- [x] Auth / session / token / capability surfaces
